n = int(input())
m = int(input())
P = int(input())

    a += b
    if a >= P:
        a -= P
    return a

def mul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % P

def mulself(a, b):
    return (a * b) % P

MAX = 511
dwu = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
dp1 = [0] * MAX
dp2 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
dp3 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
ile = [0] * MAX

for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            dwu[i][j] = 1
        else:
            dwu[i][j] = add(dwu[i - 1][j], dwu[i - 1][j - 1])

dp1[0] = 0
ile[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        pom = 0
        pom = add(pom, mul(dp1[j], ile[i - j - 1]))
        pom = add(pom, mul(dp1[i - j - 1], ile[j]))
        pom = mulself(pom, j + 1)
        temp = mul(mul(ile[i - j - 1], ile[j]), j * (j + 1) // 2)
        pom = add(pom, temp)
        pom = mulself(pom, dwu[i - 1][j])
        dp1[i] = add(dp1[i], pom)

        pom = dwu[i - 1][j]
        pom = mulself(pom, ile[j])
        pom = mulself(pom, ile[i - j - 1])
        pom = mulself(pom, j + 1)
        ile[i] = add(ile[i], pom)
    ile[i] = add(ile[i], ile[i])
    dp1[i] = add(dp1[i], dp1[i])

dp2[0][0] = 1
dp3[0][0] = 0
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(m + 1):
            if j + k <= m and i + k + 1 <= n + 1:
                pom = dp2[i][j]
                pom = mulself(pom, dwu[m - j][k])
                pom = mulself(pom, ile[k])
                pom3 = dp3[i][j]
                pom3 = mulself(pom3, ile[k])
                pom3 = add(pom3, mul(dp1[k], dp2[i][j]))
                pom3 = mulself(pom3, dwu[m - j][k])
                dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = add(dp2[i + k + 1][j + k], pom)
                dp3[i + k + 1][j + k] = add(dp3[i + k + 1][j + k], pom3)

print(dp3[n + 1][m])
